Recurrences
Recurrence: equation describing a function in terms of its value on
smaller arguments (inputs), e.g. T(n) = T(2n/3) + T(n/3) + O(n).
Three methods to solve recursive equations:
¢ Substitution guesses bound and prove correctness by induction.
* Recursion-tree converts recursion into tree, associate cost to
nodes by their level, then sum over the whole tree. (CLRS 4.4)
* Master method provides bounds of the form T(n) = aT(n/b)
+ f(n), where a > 1, b > 1 and f (n) a given function.
